text: Cooked sütlaç is poured into bowls and baked only to brown the skin, which is what makes the fırın version. Amounts are for 6 servings from yemek.com; the Hamsiköy version cooks rice in boiled milk with butter for about 15 min before the sugar goes in.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Rice, 1/2 tea glass, in 1.5 cups water.
1 l of milk is added with the sugar.

steps.name: thicken
steps.note: 1.5 tbsp cornstarch whisked with lukewarm water, and 1 egg yolk.
Boiled a couple of times, then vanilla is added.
In a water bath until the tops brown.
